synthesis_report.mission: Technical debt audit of IHIM codebase

executive_summary.estimated_fix_time: 2-3 days for critical, 5-6 days for all high-priority

critical_issues.issue: Command injection in dispatch_agent() - prompt parameter insufficiently sanitized
critical_issues.impact: Arbitrary command execution. Shell metacharacters like $(), backticks, pipes can bypass escaping.
critical_issues.fix: Use shlex.quote() or subprocess with args list instead of shell=True

critical_issues.issue: CORS configured with allow_origins=['*'] AND allow_credentials=True
critical_issues.impact: Any website can make credentialed requests to server. Violates CORS spec. Full attack surface exposed.
critical_issues.fix: Set specific origins: ['http://localhost:7777', 'http://127.0.0.1:7777']. Remove allow_credentials if not needed.
critical_issues.note: Also flagged in blackboard by security-reviewer

critical_issues.issue: create_stopwatch(stopwatch: StopwatchCreate = None) but line 660 accesses stopwatch.label
critical_issues.impact: Raises AttributeError when stopwatch=None. FastAPI treats = None as optional parameter.
critical_issues.fix: Remove default (make required) OR use Optional[StopwatchCreate] with proper None checking

critical_issues.issue: Hard-coded Windows path + shell injection via shell=True in subprocess calls
critical_issues.impact: Breaks on non-Windows. Security risk. Affects claude_workspace, edgeflow_workspace, explorer_workspace actions.
critical_issues.fix: Replace 'C:/Users/<user>/workspace' with environment variable. Remove shell=True.

high_severity_issues.issue: Logic error in health check operator precedence
high_severity_issues.description: if status == DEGRADED and 'Valid' in msg or 'stale' in msg
high_severity_issues.problem: Wrong precedence. Evaluates as (DEGRADED and Valid) OR stale instead of DEGRADED and (Valid OR stale)
high_severity_issues.impact: Will incorrectly report health status for stale files
high_severity_issues.fix: Add parentheses: if status == DEGRADED and ('Valid' in msg or 'stale' in msg)

high_severity_issues.issue: Bare except clauses catch KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit
high_severity_issues.impact: Swallows critical signals. Server hard to stop cleanly. Silent failures everywhere.
high_severity_issues.fix: Catch specific exceptions: except (BrokenPipeError, OSError, IOError). Add logging.

high_severity_issues.impact: Will break in Python 3.13+. Deprecation warnings in 3.12.
high_severity_issues.fix: Use: from datetime import datetime, timezone; datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().replace('+00:00', 'Z')

high_severity_issues.impact: Process handles not retained. collapse_team action broken. race conditions.
high_severity_issues.fix: Add proper state management and thread safety

high_severity_issues.issue: 39 skipped Flight Path tests - feature not implemented
high_severity_issues.impact: Entire Flight Path visualization feature incomplete. Tests exist as spec but no implementation.
high_severity_issues.fix: Implement Flight Path feature or remove tests if canceled

code_quality_themes.description: Widespread silent failures. Bare exception catching in 20+ locations without logging.
code_quality_themes.impact: Users cannot diagnose issues. Debugging extremely difficult.
code_quality_themes.recommendation: Add logging module with DEBUG level. Replace bare except with specific exceptions.

code_quality_themes.description: Command injection in 2 locations. CORS misconfiguration. No input validation.
code_quality_themes.impact: Arbitrary code execution possible. CSRF attacks possible.
code_quality_themes.recommendation: Security audit before production. Use shlex.quote(). Fix CORS. Validate inputs.

code_quality_themes.description: Inconsistent error responses, path construction, timestamps, CSS variables vs hard-coded.
code_quality_themes.impact: Maintenance burden. Frontend needs special-case logic for each endpoint.
code_quality_themes.recommendation: Establish conventions. Standardize API responses. Use design tokens in CSS.

code_quality_themes.description: Hard-coded Windows paths. Platform-specific features not documented.
code_quality_themes.impact: Won't work on Mac/Linux. Users confused by platform-specific buttons.
code_quality_themes.recommendation: Use environment variables. Document platform requirements. Abstract platform code.

code_quality_themes.description: CSS hard-coded colors (20+ instances), duplicate selectors, ~150 lines dead code.
code_quality_themes.impact: Changes require editing multiple locations. Hard to reason about.
code_quality_themes.recommendation: Refactor CSS to design tokens. Remove duplicates. Consolidate imports.

code_quality_themes.description: 39 skipped tests. Heavy mocking hides integration bugs. Debug print statements.
code_quality_themes.impact: Integration issues not caught. Feature incomplete.
code_quality_themes.recommendation: Implement Flight Path or remove. Add integration coverage. Use logging not print.

schema_issues: Notes: all 9 records have empty title field - feature unused
Tasks: missing created_at/updated_at - no audit trail
Stopwatches: lap time API exists but no storage schema
Stopwatches: frontend uses localStorage, backend uses JSON - divergence risk

gaps: Only 2 media queries - limited responsive design
Modals still animate for reduced-motion users
Platform-specific actions shown on wrong platforms

top_10_action_items.item: Fix command injection in terminal/routes.py:410 - use shlex.quote()
Fix command injection in actions/utils.py - remove shell=True
Fix CORS - specify exact origins, remove wildcard
Fix create_stopwatch() parameter - remove =None or handle None
Replace hard-coded paths with environment variables (3 files)
Replace bare except with specific exceptions (20+ locations)
Standardize API response format across endpoints

production_readiness.recommendation: DO NOT deploy to production until all CRITICAL issues fixed. Security vulnerabilities are exploitable. Crash bugs will cause runtime failures. High-priority issues should be addressed for maintainability and debugging capability.

findings_summary.note: No explicit TODO/FIXME/HACK comments found in codebase. All technical debt is implicit anti-patterns, security issues, and incomplete features.

key_insights: Codebase is functionally complete for implemented features but has serious quality issues
Security posture is poor - 2 command injection vulnerabilities + CORS misconfiguration
Error handling strategy is non-existent - 20+ locations with silent failures
Portability is broken - hard-coded Windows paths in 5 files
Test coverage exists but Flight Path feature (39 tests) is unimplemented
CSS is functional but maintenance burden is high due to hard-coded values
Data integrity is good - all JSON valid, but schema inconsistencies exist
System shows signs of rapid development without refactoring passes
No logging infrastructure makes debugging nearly impossible
Platform-specific code not abstracted or documented
